title: Cardinality recurrence for switching codes
statement: For all nonnegative integers $w$ and $k$, the number of switching codes of width $w$ and index $k+1$ equals $\binom{w}{k+1}2^{k+1}+\sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\binom{w}{i+1}(2^{i+1}-1)\,C(w,k-i)$, where $C(w,j)$ denotes the number of switching codes of width $w$ and index $j$.
